id./param/scenario/cs/b_120_cs_030.pack|cs_: "This strength... reminds me of the Luminary Erdwin I faced long ago...
"Damn... what? My body won't mo... ve...
"Regret your powerlessness in the afterlife. I'll devour your lives.
"Strength drains from my whole body... What is this grating sound...
"...I was born with the fate of guarding the Luminary, of the Arboria clan. Though the world perish, I'll protect you with my life.
"Serena...! You saved us. Thank you. Where have you been all this time?
"I've been alone since then, helping people suffering from Mordegon's calamity while heading to Arboria.
"I came after hearing the golden iceberg melted, and never thought I'd meet you here...
"Arboria... if we go there we'll surely learn something about the divine vessel, a clue to beating Mordegon.
"A divine vessel... such a thing... In that case, the High Priest of Arboria may know.
"...{var:1}, everyone. Please look after me again.
"Arboria lies beyond this mountain path. Let's go."
